prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” broker, but **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** looks like a good first call for a self-employed person in the Kansas City area. They say they compare individual and family ACA Marketplace plans across Kansas and Missouri, help check subsidy eligibility, and don’t charge clients directly. They’re based in Overland Park and serve the metro, including Missouri. **Call 913-333-8627** or visit [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

If you’d prefer an agency with a Missouri-side office, **B&B Insurance** in North Kansas City says it compares Missouri Marketplace plans, checks subsidies and provider networks, and serves individuals and families. **Call 816-205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/service-areas/kansas-city/).

Before enrolling, ask each broker:
- Which ACA Marketplace insurers and plans can you compare for my ZIP code?
- Can you check my doctors, hospitals, and prescriptions against the plan network and formulary?
- Will you help estimate subsidies using my **projected household income**?
- Are you paid by the insurer, and do you recommend any non-ACA plans?

For comprehensive coverage and possible subsidies, make sure you compare ACA plans through [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/)—you can also enroll there directly. Verify any broker’s Missouri license through the state insurance department.
